rationale: The plan fits the design exactly as the reference asks: one PyDESeq2 model with ~genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, WT/vehicle reference levels stated, the interaction Wald coefficient as the primary test, and both within-genotype simple effects derived by contrast from the same fit, all in Python with an explicit ban on the subset-intersection fallacy. QC (PCA, correlation heatmap, library sizes, keep-and-flag outlier policy), a cell-size-aware count >= 10 in >= 4 samples filter, median-of-ratios normalization inside the model on rounded raw counts, and BH at stated alphas with shrinkage used for ranking only are all explicit. Deductions: it does not state the fallback if the installed PyDESeq2 cannot express the interaction contrast or the LRT (which PyDESeq2 lacks), and it names ashr as an option that PyDESeq2 does not offer; the enrichment step names collections and a universe but no collection version or set-size window; and no step requires reporting package versions in the report.
